name.en: legislation.mt: Laws of Malta (Chapters and subsidiary legislation)
name.mt: legislation.mt: Liġijiet ta’ Malta (Kapitli u leġiżlazzjoni sussidjarja)

reads.en: the ELI sitemap (one request: every Chapter and piece of subsidiary legislation, with the day its entry last changed) and, for each law whose entry changed since it was last read, its page: its consolidated versions and whether it is in force
reads.mt: is-sitemap ELI (talba waħda: kull Kapitlu u kull biċċa leġiżlazzjoni sussidjarja, bil-jum li fih l-entrata tagħha nbidlet l-aħħar) u, għal kull liġi li l-entrata tagħha nbidlet minn meta nqrat l-aħħar, il-paġna tagħha: il-verżjonijiet konsolidati tagħha u jekk hijiex fis-seħħ

note.en: the English consolidated versions are compared, as this repository holds the English text
note.mt: jitqabblu l-verżjonijiet konsolidati bl-Ingliż, għax dan ir-repożitorju għandu t-test Ingliż

name.en: Government Gazette: Acts and Legal Notices (as listed on legislation.mt)
name.mt: Gazzetta tal-Gvern: Atti u Avviżi Legali (kif elenkati fuq legislation.mt)

reads.en: legislation.mt's ELI update feed (one request: the latest publications, each with its Gazette issue) and the Acts and Legal Notices of the ELI sitemap; the page of each one published since the day this repository's record runs to, once: its day of publication and the laws it amends, makes or repeals
reads.mt: il-feed ELI tal-aġġornamenti ta’ legislation.mt (talba waħda: l-aħħar pubblikazzjonijiet, kull waħda bil-ħarġa tal-Gazzetta tagħha) u l-Atti u l-Avviżi Legali tas-sitemap ELI; il-paġna ta’ kull wieħed ippubblikat mill-jum li sa fih jasal ir-rekord ta’ dan ir-repożitorju, darba: il-jum tal-pubblikazzjoni u l-liġijiet li jemenda, joħloq jew iħassar

note.en: the Gazette's own site (gov.mt) answers automated readers with a browser challenge, so its Acts and Legal Notices are read on legislation.mt; their changes reach this repository through legislation.mt's consolidated versions
note.mt: is-sit tal-Gazzetta stess (gov.mt) iwieġeb lill-qarrejja awtomatiċi bi sfida tal-browser, għalhekk l-Atti u l-Avviżi Legali tagħha jinqraw fuq legislation.mt; il-bidliet tagħhom jaslu f’dan ir-repożitorju permezz tal-verżjonijiet konsolidati ta’ legislation.mt
